The solutions to this equation are the x-coordinates of the stationary points. To determine whether each stationary point is a maximum, minimum, or saddle point, find the second derivative of the function, f''(x), and evaluate it at each stationary point. If f''(x) > 0, the point is a local minimum. If f''(x) < 0, the point is a local maximum.
